This is accompanied by severe 'structural_collapse' (Severity 5) of the firearm itself and 'anatomical_distortion' (Severity 4-5) of the human subject, as evidenced by the pose auditor's high-risk flagging of limb keypoints. The image is nonsensical from a physical and biological standpoint.
